create_pendulum_swingup_environment: create a pendulum swingup task environment with a configurable time limit and random seed
get_pendulum_observation: get the pendulum observation dict containing pole orientation and angular velocity from physics state
compute_pendulum_reward: compute the pendulum swingup reward using cosine tolerance on the pole vertical component
initialize_pendulum_episode: initialize a pendulum episode by setting the hinge to a random angle between negative and positive pi
access_pendulum_physics: access pendulum physics properties including pole vertical component, angular velocity, and pole orientation
